results.name: setup creates four tabs and appends new columns without moving legacy order data
login issues valid session and token change revokes old session
five bad token attempts throttle further guesses but do not lock out the rightful owner
public GET allow-list hides owner email and token hash
valid product saves with derived Few Left status
product price decimals, negative stock and unsafe image links are rejected
creating a product is idempotent when the browser retries after a lost response
manual status cannot claim In Stock when the stock count is zero
checkout rejects punctuation-only phone numbers
manual product status stays locked when stock changes
duplicate product lines are aggregated before stock validation
placeOrder stores pending order, CRM opt-in and sends two notifications
same request ID returns existing order without duplicate CRM count or emails
order is saved when email quota is exhausted, and the owner can retry both notifications safely
markPaid deducts exact stock once and recomputes CRM spend
manual status lock cannot keep a zero-stock product looking available
oversubscribed pending orders trigger low-stock warning then explicit force
pending order cancellation is allowed, and paid order cancellation is refused
product deletion is blocked while a pending order still references it
paid order snapshots remain readable after its product is deleted
prepared payment recovery reapplies absolute stock targets and does not double count
receipt email failure is reported and can be retried without stock changes
settings reject protected keys and invalid configuration
formula-like customer and product text is escaped before entering Google Sheets
dashboard, orders, products and customers endpoints return consistent CRM data
daily summary sends owner email and includes stock table
API rejects inherited object properties as route names
v3: wrong token is slowed outside any lock, and the right token still works
v3: stale edit form cannot overwrite live stock
v3: price must be at least 1 and original price must be higher than price
v3: created_at is set once by the backend and survives edits
v3: backfillProductDates stamps only products that have no date
v3: a +234 phone is stored untouched and an identical retry returns the same order
v3: WhatsApp numbers saved in local format are normalised on save, on read and on migration
v3: undo payment restores stock once, resets the order and survives an interruption
v3: undo after a forced shortage restores only what was actually deducted
v3: best sellers rank paid units only and expose no customer data
v3: public payload is cached without a lock and cleared by product, settings and delete writes
v3: one damaged order row cannot break the dashboard orders list
v3: daily summary reports the day that just ended when it runs just after midnight
